name: Friends Party Game
agentBrief: A finished online party game for 2 to 10 players (Summer Engine, Godot 4, 3D, GDScript), made to be built on. ENTRY SCENE: res://main.tscn. Press PLAY, everybody stands on the lobby circle, Enter (pad Y) starts the game the cast picked. It plays offline with two players on one keyboard (WASD + Q/E turn + F grab; IJKL + U/O turn + N grab; demo/game/game_input.gd lists the rest) and online through Summer multiplayer. PICK THE GAME: one setting, "mode" in res://cast/cast.json: "show" (default: three rounds, a race, a falling-floor survival and a crown climb, levels 14-16), "carry" (2 players carry a painting or, with "object": {"kind": "glass"}, a glass pane; 3+ players keep a balloon up), or the minigames "who_said_it", "friend_swap", "hot_potato", "shove_off". Set the mode closest to what the person asked for, then make it theirs. EASY CHANGES: res://cast/cast.json and the fixed-name files next to it (team name, tagline, player names and colours, words, logo, pictures, banners, hero prop); a missing field falls back to the template. LEVELS are data: res://levels/level_NN.json (blocks, hazards, kill and goal zones, waypoints); prefer a new level file over code; "pool": false keeps a level out of random runs. MODES: res://modes/<id>/rules.gd (rules, authority side) and view.gd (what players see), list in res://modes/modes.json. LOOK: res://character/ and res://courier/ (players, outfits, heads), res://style/ (world look), res://client/ (menus, HUD, online screens, touch controls). NETWORK RULE: res://game/game_run.gd runs the same simulation in three roles, local (one keyboard), authority (server, res://authority/main.tscn) and replica (each online player, res://client/main.tscn). Put gameplay rules on the authority side (res://network/match_controller.gd, modes/<id>/rules.gd) and visuals in views, then check both one keyboard and online. Use only Summer multiplayer, never vanilla Godot networking. Do not hand-edit res://network/composition.tres, res://client/main.tscn or res://authority/main.tscn: the repo's tools/build_network.gd regenerates them. summer.build.json ships a placeholder gameId; online publishing needs the person's own game id from Summer Studio. Full notes (README, AGENTS.md, docs/modes.md, docs/multiplayer.md, docs/level-format.md, docs/slots.md) live in the template repo, not in this project. CUSTOMIZE BY: cast, levels, a mode, the look; keep the three-role game_run spine and the network files.

userFacing.tagline: A finished online party game for 2 to 10 friends: race, survive, carry something fragile, wear the crown.
highlights: The Show: a race, a falling-floor survival and a climb to the crown
Glass carry and balloon co-op modes, plus four lobby minigames
Grab, throw and shove other players and props
Plays on one keyboard and online with Summer multiplayer
Levels are plain data files, modes are one folder each
